sources.title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
sources.snippet: We trained Gemma models on up to 6T tokens of text, using architectures, data, and training recipes inspired by the Gemini model family. Like Gemini, these models achieve strong generalist capabilities in text domains, alongside state-of-the-art understanding and reasoning skills at scale.
